answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, slashed if peers prove duplicate or fraudulent behaviour. Like timber that must be seasoned before building, reputation cannot be faked overnight: new identities start with tiny limits and earn larger limits only through verified, useful work. A Sybil farm then faces real cost per copy, while an oasis of trusted agents can whisper warnings through signed attestations that quickly quarantine clones.
